latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of music-search.

- Search for music resources (songs, albums, lossless formats) from Quark, Baidu, Aliyun, and UC Netdisks.
- Supports filtering by netdisk type, audio format (FLAC, APE, WAV, DSD, Hi-Res, etc.), and result limit.
- Two search engines: deep (web page crawling + extraction) and web (surface-level).
- Includes commands to search resources, get popular recommendations, and resolve redirected links.
- Outputs results in structured JSON with details like title, link, format, extraction code, and source.
- Customizable preferences via .env file for netdisk priority, deep search settings, and concurrency.
- Requires Python 3 and the web-search skill; dependencies install automatically on first use.
